proof_body:
by
  intro a k
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + k), a i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a i + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a (i + k) := by
    intro m
    rw [add_comm m k, Finset.sum_range_add]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [add_comm]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, h⟩
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a i + s, ?_⟩
    rw [← Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat k]
    simp only [key]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.add h
  · rintro ⟨s, h⟩
    refine ⟨s - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a i, ?_⟩
    have h2 := (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat k).2 h
    refine (h2.sub_const (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a i)).congr fun m => ?_
    rw [key]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ), (∃ s : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a (i + k)) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) ↔ ∃ s : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a i) Filter.atTop (nhds s)
